title: A3 — J2/J3 genuinely-live under-traffic migration probe (single-worker API)

provenance.coordination_note: WP-3/WP-4 migration SM logic is VERIFIED in-process (test_concurrency_aware_migration_sm.py, 181e86a) and J2/J3 RESOLVED via the probe, but genuinely-live under-traffic verification is still open: it NEEDS A SINGLE-WORKER API (multi-worker --workers 6 confounds session affinity). Probe shape: same session_id reused across turns (forces session-handover -> forward migration = J2) + load oscillation above then below safe slots (-> reverse migration = J3). Drive via the autopilot eval-concurrency path, not external /chat (F3: rate-limited).

preconditions.stack_lineup: SINGLE-WORKER API (--workers 1) so session affinity is not confounded; placement SM enabled

execution.protocol_id: P-AB-1 (live migration observation via single-worker eval-concurrency path)

outcomes.expected: Forward migration (J2) fires on session-handover and reverse migration (J3) fires on load drop-off, observed live under traffic on a single-worker API — closing the last WP-3/WP-4 gap.

gate_table.gate: Do forward (J2) and reverse (J3) migrations fire correctly under live single-worker traffic?
gate_table.evidence: kv_migration_direction_total{forward|reverse} + thrash_skipped counters over the reuse-session/oscillation probe, P-AB-1

pass.rule: forward migration on handoff AND reverse migration on load-drop, no thrash, counters match SM logic
action: flip the live under-traffic migration-probe checkbox; advance WP-6/WP-7 ratification

marginal.rule: migrations fire but with occasional cooldown-suppressed thrash events
action: record observation; annotate thrash guard behavior; keep WP-7 rollout pending

fail.rule: migration fails to trigger, or triggers spuriously / thrashes
action: keep WP-6/WP-7 rollout gated; document the live-trigger gap in within-role handoff

infra.classify: multi-worker API confound / single-worker launch failure / dispatch starvation
action: assert --workers 1; drive via eval-concurrency (never /chat); re-run in a fresh quiet window
hold for operator; attach migration counter timeseries + session trace

ledger.journal_quarantine_rule: record migration direction counts, thrash_skipped reason, session reuse pattern, load profile; quarantine diagnostic_only if run against a multi-worker API (affinity confounded).
